apps.localizedDescription:
Table Habit is a free and open-source habit tracker that helps you build micro habits with a unique scoring system, rich growth charts, and cross-device WebDAV sync. Available on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux — no ads, no account required. See the translation badge above for supported languages. Licensed under Apache 2.0.

Why Table Habit?:

• 📊 Smart Scoring — Not Just Streaks Quantifies your consistency beyond daily check-ins. Growth curves show your long-term progress with separate scoring models for "do" and "don't" habits.
• 🔄 WebDAV Sync — Own Your Data Sync seamlessly across devices via Nextcloud, Koofr, or self-hosted servers. Zero vendor lock-in and complete data privacy — your habit data always stays yours.

versions.localizedDescription:
Released: v1.27.18+207:

Table Habit now supports iOS Home Screen widgets! Thanks to @IlyaPalochkin for contributing the initial interactive widgets (#680).

✨ Features:

• Add interactive Home Screen widgets for iOS 17+, with seven-day progress and check-in, undo and refresh actions without opening the app (#680).
• Choose automatic or fixed habits, including archived habits; fixed habits appear first. Small, medium and large widgets show up to one, three and six habits respectively (#687).
• Keep automatic check-ins visible until tapping Next to show another habit; widgets on the same device share check-in and Next updates. Fixed habits stay visible with Undo. Show a completion message when all goals are complete, or No pending habits when incomplete or skipped goals leave no rows (#687).
• Mark ordinary habits incomplete with Missed, distinguish ordinary and negative habit record states, and display labels in the app language (#687).

🐛 Fixes:

• Improve foldable-screen layouts: fit dialogs, sheets and date/time pickers to the selected screen area, and place confirmations in the right or lower area (#691).
• Keep toolbars, sidebars, search and floating controls clear of window controls (#691).
• Preserve navigation state across safe-area changes and fix Material localization reloads (#691).

🧹 Others:

• Standardize Swift formatting and add formatting checks to local and CI workflows (#688).
• Update adaptive UI dependencies and select stable Xcode 27.x in CI (#691).
• Refresh Apple build dependency locks.
• Update contributor credits.
